messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU capacity alarm for prod-cluster-pool (queue length +350% over 5m). Autoscaler failing to attach new nodegroup. See /incidents/3412345678 for context

mike_oncall: I’m on it. Seeing heavy spike in inference queue, p50 latency doubled. Any recent deploys?

lara_infra: No deploys from infra in last hour. Autoscaler logs show AttachInstanceProfile API 403 for the new nodegroup launchtemplate. Suspect IAM role mismatch.

pranav_runtime: Linking logs — runtime is creating many pending pods in gpu-nodepool. All pending due to PendingVolume/insufficient resources reported by k8s-autoscaler. Also getting taint mismatch on new nodes: nodeAffinity requires `gpu=true` taint but launchtemplate uses `accelerator:nvidia` tag.

natalie_custops: Any customer impact? A few customers reported slow batch jobs in the dashboard, one support ticket flagged real-time churn.

mike_oncall: Assessing impact: ~12 customers have timed-out requests in the last 10m, mostly low-tier self-serve. Escalating to SE team. Marking incident P1.

joel_prod: Can we do an immediate fallback to cpu-backed small model variant for non-critical routes to reduce GPU pressure? We can reroute A/B by route config.

pranav_runtime: Yes, we have a compatible float16 CPU quantized variant (cpu-q1) for most image/embedding workloads. Would save ~70% GPU tokens. But need to update routing policy in the console. I can do a quick canary for 10% traffic to cpu-q1.

lara_infra: Meanwhile the autoscaler error details:
```
E0315 12:34:11 scaler.go:211] attach failed: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation
status code: 403, request id: f1a2b3c4
launchTemplate: lt-0a1b2c3
```
We likely rolled a new instance profile without the proper passRole.

mike_oncall: Plan: 1) canary route 10% traffic to cpu-q1 (pranav) 2) manual scale up a fallback GPU nodegroup with older launchtemplate that has correct IAM (lara) 3) open emergency IAM rollback (infra) 4) customer comms note (natalie). Who owns step 2?

lara_infra: I can create the fallback nodegroup in the existing ASG with launchtemplate lt-older-2025 which has known-good instance profile. Will do a manual scale to +6 GPUs to drain queue. ETA 8-10m.

pranav_runtime: Starting canary now. Pushing route change:
```
route update --service inference-api --route stable --weight cpu-q1=10,gpu-prod=90 --comment "emergency fallback canary"
```
Switching...

deploy-bot: Route update succeeded: inference-api stable weights now cpu-q1=10,gpu-prod=90 (rollout id r-20260315-001).

mike_oncall: Nice. Monitor latency & error rate on canary. Natalie please prep comms for affected customers with a short ETA and mitigation steps.

natalie_custops: Drafting now. Will email only customers seeing timeouts and post status page note. ETA 5m. Also reaching out to one enterprise paying customer flagged by support.

lara_infra: Fallback nodegroup created and scaled to +6 GPUs. Kube shows new nodes Ready but they inherit taint accelerator:nvidia=true which runtime rejects. I’m going to patch node taints to match runtime expectation (`gpu=true:NoSchedule`) then let pods migrate. Command I’ll run:
```
kubectl get nodes -l nodegroup=fallback-gpu -o name | xargs -I{} kubectl taint nodes {} accelerator:nvidia- true- || true
kubectl taint nodes <node> gpu=true:NoSchedule-
```
Running now.

pranav_runtime: If you remove accelerator:nvidia and add gpu=true taint that should match the pod toleration. Also we should remove the taint incrementally to avoid churn.

lara_infra: Patch applied. New nodes report Ready and kube-scheduler is binding pending pods. Queue length started to plateau.

pranav_runtime: Observability: inference queue dropped from +350% down to +40% in 6m, p50 latency trending back to normal. No increased 5xxs on canary. Looks good.

mike_oncall: Great. Next steps: keep canary at 10% for 30m, begin IAM rollback to restore autoscaler launchtemplate permissions (infra+security), then re-enable autoscaler to create nodegroups with correct instance profile. Avoid deleting fallback nodegroup until autoscaler fully validated.

lara_infra: IAM rollback ticket created STS-891, pushing policy revert now. If rollback succeeds, we’ll test scale up with a dry-run.

joel_prod: After stabilization let's do a postmortem on why launchtemplate drift happened and add a preflight check in CI for instance profile permissions. Also consider a runtime switch to auto-fallback to CPU variant when queue growth > X% instead of paging immediately.

natalie_custops: Sent update to affected customers and status page. So far only one enterprise reported degraded throughput; we offered temporary priority routing to fallback GPUs.

mike_oncall: Thanks all for fast sync. I’ll keep monitoring and will switch channel to #postmortems once stabilized. For now marking incident mitigated but still P1 until autoscaler confirmed healthy. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 3412345678 status changed to MITIGATED (partial) by mike_oncall at 2026-03-15T12:56:00Z
